literal: Wealth accrued by theft, having exceeded the limit, will perish like it is growing.
translation: Wealth accumulated through theft may seem to grow beyond all limits, but it will ultimately perish.
modern: திருடுவதால் சேர்ந்த செல்வம், எல்லையைக் கடந்து பெருகுவது போலத் தோன்றினாலும், முடிவில் அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns about the deceptive nature of ill-gotten wealth. The word 'ஆக்கம்' generally means creation or increase, but here it specifically refers to wealth or prosperity. The phrase 'களவினால்' indicates that this wealth is acquired through stealing. Although such wealth might appear to grow boundlessly ('அளவு இறந்து ஆவது போல'), this growth is an illusion. The verse concludes with 'கெடும்', emphasizing that it will inevitably be destroyed.
